book.name: MATEU
book.title: Eliywi no kuwaba lya Jesu Kilesite eli lina kun̄oliwa kwa MATEU

content: Enguli no Akatana noku Kwana Likumi
Ba nako eyo omubuso naku wilu kame sokufeke kanyi eso sina kutendahala abo akatana noku kwana likumi aba ana ku shimba amaboni oo ni kuta oka waniketa omukwati.
Ana kukwana mutanu kwa onyene neli aelo, mi mutanu neli ano kushangama.
Cwale aelo no kukwana mutanu kasiku shimbela amaboni oo amaati no kupula,
kono ano kushangama kame ana ku shimba amaati mwishimbelo yoo, bamweya ni maboni oo.
Cwale kakuli omukwati kame ana ku liyeha bakwiiya, sebeli akosa onje ni ku langana.
Kono bakaci no usiku omuhuwo sebeli o yupahala nji, ‘Komumone, omukwati uno! Ko mwiiye mu mu wanikete!’
Cwale akatana awo sebeli ainguka onje ni kutateka oku lukisa amaboni oo.
Cwale ano kweluba sebeli amba kwaa ano kushangama nji, “Mu tube ku maati enu, kakuli amaboni etu kame atima.”
Kono ano kushangama sebeli aa tambula nji, “Ka ku twesahala! katamba ku tu kwana aci naanyi. Mute kwa aulisi nji mu ka ku ulele eenu.”
Mi cwale akatana no kweluba asita feela mukuula amaati, omukwati sebeli okeela, mi awo ana kuku tukiseta sebeli aingena naye mu mukiti no likwala, mi esaandi sebeli siyatiliwa.
Munyima nweyo, akatana anjili sebeli aiya nonyene ni kwamba nji, ‘Mbumu, Mbumu! otu yatulwele.’
Kono omukwati sebeli otambula nji, “Niti luli kame ni myambela nji, kani mi yii.”
Cwale mwikale anyi me mutona, kakuli kamu limuka eliywaa simba enako eyo saiye Omwana no munu.
Enguli no Abika Aatu
Omubuso naku wilu kame okufekile kanyi eso sina kutendahala abo omulume aba ano kutukiseta okuta mu mwendo waye, sebeli oisana abika aye ni kwaambela nji ababalele ofumu waye.

Sebeli oba omunjili amasaka no mali noku kwana mutanu, omunjili sebeli omuba amasaka ayiili no mali, omunjili esaka no mali imweya, sebeli oba omunjili ni munjili oku faniketa nomo atwesela. Cwale sebeli okutela.
Cwale woyo ona ku biwa amasaka mutanu no mali, ababo sebeli oka belekisa ni ku wanenabo kame no kukwana mutanu.
Mi kame ni woyo ona kubiwa amasaka ayiili sebeli ota okabelekisa ni kuwanenabo kame amasaka ayiili.
Kono woyo ona kubiwa esaka iweya no mali sebeli ota, nuka tombola owina banji niku shweeka amali no molyaye.
Cwale aba kuna kubita amaywaa no kupula omolya abika awo sebeli oiya, mi sebeli waisana nji amone omo ana belekisete amali aye.

Cwale woyo ona kutambula amasaka mutanu no mali sebeli oiya kwa molyaye okulita amasaka no mali kame noku kwana mutanu ni kwamba nji, ‘Molyange kame ona kuniba amasaka mutanu no mali, komone, kame nina wanenebo kame masaka mutanu no mali beulu.’
Omolyaye sebeli wamba kwa yonyene nji, ‘Nu tende wino, mi uli mubika no kuwaba ni ku sepahala! Nu sepahala ku inu no kucaniba, mba niku beeke okubusa eyi no kupula. Wingene mu kuwabelwa kwa molyowe!’
Mi ni woyo ona kubiwa amasaka ayiili no mali, sebeli oiya kwa molyaye ni kwamba nji, ‘Molyange, kame ona kuniba amasaka ayiili no mali, Omone! kame nina wanenebo kame amasaka ayiili no mali.’

Omolyaye sebeli wamba kwa yonyene nji, ‘Nu tende wino, wene omubika no kuwaba niku sepahala, nu twese oku sepahala mu inu no kucaniba, mba niku beeke okubusa eyi no kupula, wingene mu kuwabelwa kwa molyowe!’

Cwale ni woyo ona kubiwa esaka imweya no mali, ni yonyene sebeli oiya ni kwamba nji, “Molyange, kame niku limukile nji wene uli mulume noku bambaba, woyo ukutula omu wasi kuna, mi kame uungeka omu kausi kwaa embuto.
Cwale kakuli kame nina kucila, sebeli nita okatombola owina banji niku pumbeka esaka yowe no mali mu mumbu. Esinu sowe sino sokame.”
Kono omolyaye sebeli omu tambula nji, ‘Wene omubika no kwiiba ni kububa! Kame wamba nji kame olimukile nji kame ni kutula omo kanisi kuna, mi kame ni ungeka omo kanasi kwaa embuto.
Cwale kame onaku fanena nji obeeke amali ange mu Panga, mi aba ni nauku kambe nonu sete amali ange niku beekelabo en̄ambekelo.
Cwale mu mu biangule esaka no mali, mi mube kwa woyo okwite amasaka likumi no mali.
Kwaawo akwite, mba beekelwa, mi mba ikala neyi nokupula, kono kwaawo aulwile mane kame sa byanguliwe neyo akwite.
Kanyi kwa woyo omubika nambulwa tuso, mu mu kondele ku uwi, oko salila ni kukweca amaeo.
Eliywaa no Katulo
“Cwale omwana no munu aba saiye mu kanya yaye, yoli ni Mangeloi aye onje, kame saikale ba lubona no kanya yaye.
Mba ku ungana ba lubala lwaye amacaba onje, mi mba kete aanu anjili kwaa njili, kanyi omulisana aba ataba omukoko mu tupuli.
Mi kame sa beeke omukoko ku lyoko lyaye no silyo, mi abeeke otupuli kweli no simoo.
Cwale molyoo kame saambe kwaawo ali ku lyoko lyaye no silyo nji, ‘Komwiye! anyi muna fuyolwa kwa Sitange! Mu yole omubuso ona ku lukisetwa anyi okutunda ku matatekelo no litunga.
Ni wenu kakuli kame nina ku yomba, mi sebeli muniba esi no kulya, mi kame nina kufa elinyotwa, mi sebeli muniba esi no kunwa, kame nina kutenda ongenda, mi sebeli muni tambula,
kame nina kuulwa esikumango, mi sebeli muniba esi no ukumanga, kame nina kutoma, mi sebeli muni babalela, kame nina kwikala mu tolongo, mi sebeli mwiiya mukunilekula.
Cwale ano kuluka kame sa mu tambule nji, ‘Molyetu, ka mwaka tuna ku kumona wo yombile, mi sebeli tu kuba esi no kulya, simba wofile elilyotwa ni kukuba esi no kunwa?
Mi cwale ka mwaka aba tuna kuku mona o endile ongenda, mi sebeli tuku tambula, simba oulwile esikumango, mi sebeli tu kuba esi no kukufuka?
Mi cwale ka mwaka tu naku ku mona me u tomine, simba ouli mu tolongo, mi sebeli twiiya kwa wene mu kukupotela?
Mi molyowo mba atambula nji, ‘Niti luli kame ni myambela nji kwawo abange acana muna kutendela ngeeso, yamene muna kutenda ngeeso!’
Cwale kame saambe kwawo ali ku lyoko no simoo nji, ‘Anyi mu kutilwe kwa Nyambe, mutunde kwa mene, mute mu mulilo no kwaabwa, ou u lukisetwe Diabulosi ni mangeloi aye!
Kame ni tenda ngeesi kwaanyi kakuli kame ni naku yomba, mi ka mwasiku niba esi no kulya, kame nina kufa elinyotwa mi kamwasikuniba esi no kunwa.
Kame nina kutenda ongenda, mi ka mwasikuni tambula, kame nina kuulwa esikumango, mi ka mwasi kuni fuka, kame nina kukola, ni kwikala mu tolongo, mi ka mwasi kwiiya mu kuni lekula.

Cwale nonyene kame samu tambule nji, ‘Molyetu, ka mwaka tuna kuku mona woyombile, simba wofile elinyotwa, simba wotendile ongenda, simba wo ulwile esikumango, simba wotomine, simba mu tolongo, mi sebeli tu kwangwa oku kubabalela?’
Cwale kame saatambule nji, “Niti luli kame ni myambela nji aba muna kukwangwa oku babalela omunjili kwaa acana ngeeso, yamene muna kukwangwa oku babalela ngeeso.”
Mi awo kame saate mu koto no kwaabwa, kono awo no kuluka kame saate mu mooyo no kwaabwa.
